answer: Best Buy's net earnings (net income) decreased from $2,454 million in fiscal year 2022 to $1,419 million in fiscal year 2023, representing a decrease of 42.2%.
rationale: Net earnings for fiscal 2023 were $1,419 million and for fiscal 2022 were $2,454 million. The percentage change is calculated as (1,419 - 2,454) / 2,454 * 100 = -42.176%, which rounds to -42.2%.
